column1: # M15 item 8 reflection audit: tests/visual/reflection-audit.sh on the render host at 1280x800 1920x1080, revision 4d1d246c, 2026-10-06, test card; mirror = the picture with REFLECT minus without.

# expected: mirror when the package declares one (no placement drops a DS or 3DS shell, M15 item 2); none for computed layouts. reach0/reach1: each screen's own mirror pixels over its picture's perimeter (about the band's mean width, px).

# package: the package the renderer's debug line names, which must be the variant's own; a variant that declares an output (wii tv_wide) is drawn through the variant listing it under outputs (wii tv) on a 16:9 card, as a launch reaches it.

# live: the path that hands the compositor its frame on the Deck; every path ends in semu_render_game_gl, which crops (N64) and extracts the reported content rect, so the mirror samples what the emulator presents there.
